items.title: Allan Jaffe Interview, 1969-04-16
items.q: The interviewee discusses Sales becoming leader of the George Lewis band and mentions Sales in the context of hiring decisions and band dynamics, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship between himself and Sales.

ctx.x: Tom Decker, his human and Russell, came over for the first time.

And, right when the hall started, George left town. And he never played at the hall, you know, when it was actually a hall. And he was, the first time he really started playing, he came back from a trip. Where'd he go in, 61? I think he went. To Europe? To the Dardy Tate. Yeah. Yeah. He came back. He came over, came over here, went back, and I asked him if he would like to bring in a band. And he said, no, he would rather, you know, be a sideman. So he started playing with Thomas' band.
